content.description:
Dotare is the decentralized endowment for delivering global universal basic income.

Dotare empowers benefactors to directly support beneficiaries around the world by leveraging the Cardano blockchain and cryptocurrency technologies to deliver an inclusive, sustainable, and privacy-respecting financial foundation for everyone.
content.meta: Find out about Dotare on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions. Get immediate access to the project Website, Social Media, Whitepaper and Token distribution.
